expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Appends Other and returns this string, including on temporary strings. Appends one UTF-16 code unit and returns this string. Appends the decimal representation of InNum. Inserts one UTF-16 code unit at Index. Inserts Characters at Index. Removes all characters and releases allocated storage. Removes all characters and reserves Slack UTF-16 code units. Removes all characters while retaining or resizing reusable storage. Reserves storage for at least Count UTF-16 code units. Shrinks allocated storage to the current string length.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Use the returned reference in a follow-up mutation or identity check to prove aliasing.
inputs: Seeded receiver state, the exact mutation arguments, repeated-call behavior, and cleanup or restoration inputs where the operation owns resources.
testScope: FString& FString.Append(const FString& Other); | FString& FString.AppendChar(int16 Character); | void FString.AppendInt(int32 InNum); | void FString.InsertAt(int32 Index, int16 Character); | void FString.InsertAt(int32 Index, const FString& Characters); | void FString.Empty(); | void FString.Empty(int Slack); | void FString.Reset(int NewReservedSize = 0); | void FString.Reserve(int Count); | void FString.Shrink();
